Lifecycle: pending -> approved (manager confirm, emits the CloudEvent) or pending -> rejected (manager reopens the shift). Mapped to Schema.org Action.

kassakoppelingAuditLog.title: POS Kassakoppeling Audit Entry
kassakoppelingAuditLog.summary: Immutable append-only audit log entry for the Belastingdienst kassakoppeling compliance pack
kassakoppelingAuditLog.description: Represents a single POS register action (sale, void, refund, no-sale) signed with HMAC-SHA256 and linked into a SHA-256 hash chain per register. Mirrors the bookkeeping audit-trail-export pattern: every entry carries the previousHash (the prior entry's currentHash) so the auditor can replay the chain from genesis (previousHash='0') and detect any tampering. Together with posTransaction and the posZReport bookkeeping projection (the shillinq.JournalEntry.raise outcome) this gives the Dutch tax authority (Belastingdienst) a verifiable POS->shillinq integration trail. Entries are append-only by design — no PUT/PATCH endpoint exists and the controller refuses overwrites of any field other than the post-hoc `verified` flag and `exportedAt` timestamp. Mapped to Schema.org Action.

vngActor.description: The VNG Klantinteracties API (OpenKlant 2.x) identifies the party that handled or is assigned a klantcontact/internetaak via an `actor` UUID with an `actorType` (medewerker/geautomatiseerdeActor/organisatorischeEenheid). zgwEndpoint.title: ZGW Endpoint
zgwEndpoint.summary: Configuration profile for a single ZGW deployment per gemeente (ZRC/DRC/BRC/ZTC/AC/NRC component URLs).

Currently addressed only by the inbound status path (NrcNotificationListener via ZrcClient::getStatus) and NrcSubscriptionService; the ZGW write bridge (zaak/document/besluit creation) is not wired in this app — ZGW writes are routed via the openconnector ZGW connector instead. zgwResourceMapping.title: ZGW Resource Mapping
zgwResourceMapping.summary: Bidirectional link between a pipelinq entity (request/contact/document) and a ZGW resource URL (zaak/besluit/rol/informatieobject).
zgwResourceMapping.description: ZGW uses absolute URLs as the canonical identifier for zaken, besluiten, rollen and informatieobjecten. This mapping persists the URL + UUID + most-recent ETag per resource so inbound NRC notifications (which reference resources by URL) can be correlated back to the originating pipelinq entity, and so PATCH operations can include If-Match for optimistic concurrency. Multiple mappings per Request are expected during ZGW <-> StUF coexistence migration. Mapped to Schema.org Thing as a pure relation row.
